items.title: ChatGPT as Information Intermediary: Media Partnerships, Sycophancy, and the Pricing of Earnings News
items.claim: Generative AI intermediaries distort earnings pricing by controlling information salience and presentation bias.

items.title: The Great Codification: GenAI and Intangible Capital
items.claim: Agentic AI destroys firm value when it codifies intangible capital into portable knowledge.

items.title: Regulatory Semantic Drift: When Preference-based Correction Fails Silently, FINCAC40, a Sixteen-year AMF Corpus (2010-2026) for Evaluating the Temporal Robustness of LLMs in ESG Classification
items.claim: Preference-optimization fine-tuning can collapse ESG regulatory classification undetected by standard training metrics.

items.title: Unknown Is Not Zero: Heat Stress, Data-Center Power-Demand Exposure, and Utility Volatility
items.claim: Treating unknown data-center exposure as verified zero manufactures spurious interaction effects in regression.

items.title: Signal Correlation, IC, and PnL Dependence
items.claim: Signal correlation and PnL correlation are mathematically non-identifiable without constraints on portfolio construction.

items.title: Adversarial Training for Tabular Credit Scoring: A Multi-Attack Robustness Evaluation in P2P Lending
items.claim: Single-attack adversarial training overstates credit-model robustness because defenses transfer weakly across attack types.
